symbols.name: sample space
symbols.meaning: The finite set of all possible outcomes of the experiment.
symbols.quote: Fix a finite set $\Xi$, the sample space, whose elements are all the possible outcomes of an experiment.

symbols.name: event
symbols.meaning: An event, a subset of the sample space consisting of the outcomes in which the event occurs.
symbols.quote: An event is a subset $\mathcal{A} \subseteq \Xi$, the set of outcomes in which the event occurs.

symbols.name: second event
symbols.meaning: A second event, also a subset of the sample space.
symbols.quote: Events are written $\mathcal{A}$, $\mathcal{B}$, and so on, and each one is a subset of $\Xi$.

symbols.name: probability
symbols.meaning: The function giving the probability $\Pr(\mathcal{A})$ of an event $\mathcal{A}$, a real number between 0 and 1.
